race.comment: DIRTY HARRY (8) is hard to look past after shedding the maiden tag here when resuming at the latest. He's lightly raced and keeps Thornton piloting. Can win again. EXTREME SPIRIT (4) made things tough for himself after blundering the start but picked up strongly in the lane to nab third. Strips fitter and if he can settle in the same postcode as them this time he can get the job done. DECADAD (1) had enough go wrong at Gold Coast Poly to be assessed more kindly. Will improve with that run out of the way and McColm's claim sets him up a treat at the weights. Can forgive. PEWTER PEARL (7) will find this a bit easier and gets a more senior hoop taking over. Should improve third-up.
